problem: Make merged-head, lane acceptance, and merge consumption fail closed with immutable evidence
notes: Manager-owned Phase 0 prerequisite. OpenCode CLI Space Bunny Free max effort, uncapped input/output, no fallback. The worker leaves changes dirty for manager review; no direct merge or push. The manager must review the exact SHA and persist the report before P1 lanes start. The first worker was abandoned after the runtime terminated on a failed read of an out-of-scope helper; its four dirty files remain preserved in the worktree. A recovery lane receives those files as an in-worktree starting point and must independently review and prove them before manager acceptance.
